meta.title: Chimney Flashing & Waterproofing Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Chimney leak repair in Toronto & the GTA: new step and counter flashing, sealed properly — no tar-over shortcuts. Free inspection, price before work.

hero.p: The joint where your chimney meets the roof is where most chimney leaks begin. We trace the leak first, then replace the flashing properly — step flashing and counter flashing, no tar-over shortcuts.
hero.t-3: New step and counter flashing — no tar

signs.p: Water travels, so the stain is rarely right under the problem.
signs.p-2: On the ceiling or wall beside the chimney, often after heavy rain or snow melt.
signs.p-3: After storms — from the flashing, the crown or a missing cap.
signs.h3-3: A Damp Attic Around The Stack
signs.p-4: Wet wood or insulation where the chimney passes through.
signs.p-5: Someone has patched it before. Tar buys months, not years.
signs.p-6: Moisture behind the finish is coming from somewhere above.
signs.p-7: Not sure which one you’re seeing? That is what the free inspection is for. Book it here or call {{site.phone}}.

faq.q: How do I know the leak is from the chimney?
faq.p-2: Stains near the fireplace, water in the firebox after storms, or a damp attic around the stack are the usual signs. We trace the leak before touching anything.
faq.p-3: Tar buys months, not years, and it makes the proper repair harder later. We replace the flashing itself.
faq.p-4: The second layer, set into the masonry, that covers the step flashing. The two-layer system is what keeps water out.
faq.q-4: Do you waterproof the brick too?
faq.p-5: Yes — breathable masonry waterproofing where it makes sense, so the brick sheds water without trapping moisture.
faq.p-6: It depends on the roof, access and how far the water got, so no blind numbers online. The inspection is free and the price is set at your home before any work.
